gaps: A dedicated assertion that the saved question contains exactly the remaining options after Add Option, Enter, Delete, and Delete All for both Single Select and Radio

plan.title: Configure Single Select and Radio Options

args.goal: Starting from the Add New Question popup, configure a Single Select question and then a Radio question. For each type, add distinct options using Add Option and Enter, delete one option with its Delete control, use Delete All to clear the options, re-add the intended remaining options, click Add to save the question, and verify on screen that the saved question lists exactly those remaining options.

steps.note: No domain step exposes the Add New Question option editor or its exact saved-option assertion, so perform the complete interaction in the current browser session and verify the resulting saved questions on screen.
Confirm the final questionnaire screen has no visible application errors or rendering failures after both questions are saved.
